svg.title: SVG Image created as MUCA2-MCU.svg date 2026-11-27T10:05:04

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 host: I2C to FT5316, TWAI (CAN 2.0B), USB-C on the module

g.desc: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 host: I2C to FT5316, TWAI (CAN 2.0B), USB-C on the module

g.text: Host: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3 (castellated SMD footprint). It provides USB-C, the 3.3 V regulator, RESET and BOOT buttons.

g.desc: Host: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3 (castellated SMD footprint). It provides USB-C, the 3.3 V regulator, RESET and BOOT buttons.

g.text: D0/D1 CAN_TX/CAN_RX (TWAI, CAN 2.0B) D2 TP_SCL (GPIO3) D3 TP_SDA (GPIO4) D4 TP_INT (GPIO5) D5 TP_RST (GPIO6)

g.desc: D0/D1 CAN_TX/CAN_RX (TWAI, CAN 2.0B) D2 TP_SCL (GPIO3) D3 TP_SDA (GPIO4) D4 TP_INT (GPIO5) D5 TP_RST (GPIO6)

g.text: I2C is remapped off the XIAO default D4/D5 to match the PCB bus order: Wire.begin(4, 3), <= 400 kHz.

g.desc: I2C is remapped off the XIAO default D4/D5 to match the PCB bus order: Wire.begin(4, 3), <= 400 kHz.

g.text: D6-D9 status LEDs (active high, ~1.5 mA): HB heartbeat, SENSE scanning, COMM USB/CAN traffic, FAULT error. D10 spare.

g.desc: D6-D9 status LEDs (active high, ~1.5 mA): HB heartbeat, SENSE scanning, COMM USB/CAN traffic, FAULT error. D10 spare.

g.text: CAN is kept off D6/D7 (UART0): the ROM prints boot logs there, which would put garbage on the bus at every reset.

g.desc: CAN is kept off D6/D7 (UART0): the ROM prints boot logs there, which would put garbage on the bus at every reset.

g.text: XIAO 3V3 pin supplies the whole board (FT5316, transceiver, LEDs: < 50 mA). 5V pin = XIAO USB VBUS; CAN-bus 5 V enters it through U3 (Power sheet).

g.desc: XIAO 3V3 pin supplies the whole board (FT5316, transceiver, LEDs: < 50 mA). 5V pin = XIAO USB VBUS; CAN-bus 5 V enters it through U3 (Power sheet).

g.text: Bottom pads (JTAG, USB, BAT) left unconnected. Keep Wi-Fi/BLE off while scanning.

g.desc: Bottom pads (JTAG, USB, BAT) left unconnected. Keep Wi-Fi/BLE off while scanning.
